# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for `fd_gui_tile`. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture and then allows only a small set of syscalls: `write`, `fsync`, `accept4`, `read`, `sendto`, `close`, and `ppoll`. The policy also checks syscall arguments so that `write`, `fsync`, `read`, `sendto`, and `close` are limited to `logfile_fd` and `gui_socket_fd`, and `accept4` is limited to the expected socket flags. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gui_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gui_tile>) function copies the generated filter into the caller buffer, and the file must not be edited by hand.
